messages:
maya (PM): ok folks — customer X wants a way to opt into a 'soft pin' for a new model version for a subset of their tenants while we run benchmark sampling. question: what do we need to ship to make that safe and measurable?
jon (Eng): clarify: soft pin = route traffic from chosen tenants to model-v2 but allow automatic fallback if latency/cost/quality degrades?
anita (Research): yes. also we need sampling harness: stratified by tenant size + example workload. recommend 10k queries per cohort, ensure we capture long-tail prompt lengths.
kevin (Ops): budget note: 10k queries across 50 cohorts => ~500k inferences. estimate +$1.2k/day if unbatched. need to cap concurrency or use batching hints. p95 latency must remain <250ms for customer SLOs.
maya (PM): acceptance criteria proposal: p95 latency delta <= +40ms, cost per 1k tokens delta <= +10%, quality regressions: no more than 2% of prompts with >0.1 BLEU/embedding-sim drop (we'll refine metric). If any threshold trips -> automatic rollback.
jon (Eng): rollout plan idea: canary cohorts 1–3 (low-risk), then a staggered ramp 10/25/50/100%. Soft-pin config snippet I tossed together:
```
soft_pin: {
  cohorts: ["cohort-A","cohort-B"],
  ttl: "7d",
  fallback_policy: "auto-failover", 
  metrics_watchlist: ["p95_latency","cost_per_1k_tokens","embed_sim_drop"]
}
```
will store cohort mapping in feature-flags service.
sophie (Sales): customer asks about SLA impact and how to opt-out quickly. they want a one-click revert and a clear comms cadence.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for model-v2 -> cohort-A (3 nodes) at 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z :rocket:
anita (Research): evaluation harness will push results to s3://redwood-evals/customerX/model-v2/cohort-A. also adding A/B calcs: embedding cosine, length-normalized logprob delta, and human eval spot-checks (10 prompts).
kevin (Ops): add metric panels: p95_latency_by_cohort, cost_delta_by_cohort, embed_sim_drop_rate. assigning to @jon to wire alerts and automatic rollback script.
jon (Eng): taking it. I will add alert: if embed_sim_drop_rate > 2% for 30m -> trigger rollback and page #oncall. will prototype rollback CLI: `rctl model rollback --cohort COHORT`.
maya (PM): great. summary: (1) research sampling plan and s3 path (anita), (2) ops dashboards + rollback (kevin/jon), (3) sales comms + opt-out UX (sophie), (4) PM will draft acceptance criteria + customer comms. follow-up sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar: Action items in thread.
